purpose: Bounded inference-time predictor pilot: teacher-predict the first k horizons, then continue from the latest teacher latent with the frozen treatment_step1000 h256 student.

scope.stage: exploratory predictor-level evaluation on existing student-generated train banks only
scope.treatment_identity: A new inference-time horizon hybrid; not the frozen student’s ordinary free-running inference or a training result.
scope.runner_boundary: The runner and PBS script read only train_banks.pt and do not read or score validation/holdout banks.
scope.authoring_boundary: During static implementation review, collection_manifest.json was read and contains validation/untouched task metadata; no validation/holdout bank, model output, or score was opened, and task selection was not changed.
scope.post_pilot: A GO permits only a separately frozen gate on fresh episodes and independent banks; it does not authorize CEM.

source.bank_contract: Each entry is one frozen 300-candidate bank with [300,5,10] actions and saved student/teacher criterion costs. Read entries with split=train only; never open the validation banks or inspect reserved holdout tasks.
source.t25_coverage: Episode 15946 terminates before its t25 replan and contributes its three t0 banks only; do not impute t25.

arms.definition: For each candidate, use official LeWM predict for the first k action tokens. If k<5, initialize the frozen h256 student with the latest teacher latent as a length-one history and predict the remaining 5-k tokens. Concatenate the prefix and continuation, then score the complete six-latent sequence with the official criterion.

controls.k0: all five horizons from the frozen student
controls.k5: all five horizons from the official teacher

arms.candidate_selection: torch.topk(cost, k=30, largest=False, sorted=True), matching the official CEM elite selection.

validity.control_cost_match: Before reporting any metric, recomputed k0 and k5 costs for every bank must each pass torch.allclose against the corresponding saved bank costs; otherwise stop without a result.

metrics.bank_regret: (mean teacher cost of scorer top30 - mean teacher cost of teacher top30) / population_std of all 300 saved teacher costs; lower is better.
metrics.top30_recall: Overlap between scorer top30 and saved-teacher top30 divided by 30.
metrics.latency: Synchronized native predictor plus official criterion wall time in milliseconds per 300 candidates, including teacher/student switching; inputs are already resident on CUDA; excludes bank/model I/O and environment work.
metrics.strata: Report t0/t25 and CEM rounds 10/20/30 separately. Episode is the statistical unit; take medians over available banks within an episode before population summaries.
metrics.primary_delta: For each episode, median over its paired banks of hybrid-minus-k0 normalized elite regret; summarize across the 16 episodes.

timing.order: Interleave arms in a deterministic rotation across repeats; synchronize CUDA before and after each timed call.

exploration_gate.go_if_either: k1 or k2 meets every condition below.
exploration_gate.unit: Episode; banks within an episode are repeated measures. Episode 15946 remains in t0 and has no t25 values.
exploration_gate.post_pilot_permission: GO is exploratory only and permits a separately frozen independent-bank gate; it never permits treatment CEM or closed-loop work.

execution.login_node_work: Control-file operations only; runner must reject login/submit/head hosts and require PBS_JOBID plus PBS_NODEFILE membership.
